pr_title: Fix weird follow circle display when rewinding through sliders in editor
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/31812.

This goes much deeper (so many gameplay things look wrong in rewind). I still believe the correct path forward is to not use transforms here. I did consider doing that for this series of classes, but it's more than a 30 minute change and I don't want to go down that rabbit hole just yet.

issue_context.title: Scrolling the timeline backwards displays a glowing circle on sliders ends
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

See in the video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d8e6bc56-4e7e-4a10-93d1-cf6c044f0f15

To reproduce this:

1. right click and "edit" on one map
2. click at any position on the bottom timing bar
3. try scrolling up slowly to let the beatmap goes backward 
4. watch if the **already-ended** slider ends has a glowing circle on it, whatever the size.

this doesn't work for every map, or at any position of one certain map; just seems randomly. And if you try to scroll down to rewind on one same position, it just goes normally displayed. It seems that on certain maps this is more likely to be reproduced, but not always = =

the map using in the attached video: [ChiliChill - 我的悲伤是水做的](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/2309267#osu/4968229)

### Screenshots or videos

_No response_

review_comments: This is the only part required for the actual fix.
This may look bad but it's not that bad because `FollowCircle` has a 1:1 relationship with a `DrawableHitObject`. This was subscribing twice somehow, but "only" twice.
